- [IERR.1.7] **What libds does on finding its own invariant broken depends on
  the state it is left with.** Where libds detects the violation before changing
  anything, it must refuse the operation with `DS_ERR_INTERNAL`, and the engine
  goes on: a new pinned intern entry after the pinned set has frozen
  ([IRET.1.4]). Where the violation means engine state cannot be trusted,
  the engine must raise an `EngineError` of fault `ENGINE_FAULT_INTERNAL`
  (`proto/engine_fault.proto#EngineFault`) and halt the tier ([LERR.1.4.7]): an
  intern reference count released past zero. During `ds_engine_free` it must
  finish releasing what it holds and raises nothing ([NCBK.2.9]).

  The disposition follows the state and not the code: a `DS_ERR_INTERNAL` that
  a callback returns halts nothing ([NCBK.1.5]).
